title: Ledger line
description: One JSON object per line in <ledger-root>/<workflow>.jsonl. Append-only. The hub (chief-of-staff workflow) reads ledgers, never sources. Workflows in the private component record only non-sensitive fields (dates, commitments, counts); vstack's check command refuses rating, candidate, promo or feedback-text fields there.
